sundowning-evening.title: Evening Agitation (Sundowning)
sundowning-evening.description: Your loved one becomes increasingly anxious and confused as evening approaches. They insist on 'going home' even though they are home.

refusal-to-bathe.title: Refusing to Bathe
refusal-to-bathe.description: Your loved one hasn't bathed in several days and becomes aggressive when you suggest it.

wandering-night.title: Nighttime Wandering
wandering-night.description: You wake up at 2am to find your loved one dressed and trying to leave the house.

repeated-questions.title: Repetitive Questions
repeated-questions.description: Your loved one has asked you the same question 15 times in the last hour. You feel your patience wearing thin.

medication-refusal.title: Medication Refusal
medication-refusal.description: Your loved one is spitting out their medications and accusing you of trying to poison them.

caregiver-burnout.title: Caregiver Overwhelm
caregiver-burnout.description: You haven't slept more than 4 hours a night in weeks. Today you lost your patience and it's weighing on you.
